steps.description: Compute quartet and doublet octahedral levels
steps.command:
cd <SANDBOX_TMP>/w && cat > fit.py << 'EOF'
from d3 import *
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
# subspaces
allup = [i for i,s in enumerate(states) if all(so[k][1]==1 for k in s)]
half = [i for i,s in enumerate(states) if sum(so[k][1] for k in s)==1]
def levels(Dq,B,C):
    H = build_H(Dq,B,C).real  # real symmetric? check below
    Hq = H[np.ix_(allup,allup)]
    q = np.sort(np.linalg.eigvalsh(Hq))
    Hh = H[np.ix_(half,half)]
    h = np.sort(np.linalg.eigvalsh(Hh))
    # remove quartet levels (each quartet spatial state appears once in half block)
    rem = list(h)
    for e in q:
        j = int(np.argmin([abs(x-e) for x in rem]))
        if abs(rem[j]-e)>1e-6: raise Exception("mismatch")
        rem.pop(j)
    return q, np.array(rem)
if __name__=="__main__":
    import sys
    Dq,B,C = 1917.0, 1000.0, 4000.0
    H = build_H(Dq,B,C)
    print("imag max", np.abs(H.imag).max())
    q,d = levels(Dq,B,C)
    print("quartet", np.round(q-q[0],1))
    print("doublet", np.round(d-q[0],1))
EOF
python3 fit.py

    Hq = H[np.ix_(allup,allup)]
    q = np.sort(np.linalg.eigvalsh(Hq))
    Hh = H[np.ix_(half,half)]
    h = np.sort(np.linalg.eigvalsh(Hh))
    # remove quartet levels (each quartet spatial state appears once in half block)
    rem = list(h)

steps.description: Least-squares fit of Dq, B, C to observed bands
steps.command:
cd <SANDBOX_TMP>/w && cat > solve.py << 'EOF'
from fit import *
obs = np.array([19170.,27260.,42610.,17050.])
def model(p):
    Dq,B,C = p
    q,d = levels(Dq,B,C)
    return np.array([q[1]-q[0], q[4]-q[0], q[7]-q[0], d[0]-q[0]])
def res(p): return (model(p)-obs)
best=None
for B0 in [600,800,1000]:
    for C0 in [3000,4000,4500]:
        r = least_squares(res,[1917,B0,C0],x_scale=[1000,500,1000])
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
print("params Dq,B,C:", best.x)
print("model:", model(best.x)); print("resid:", best.fun)
print("C/B", best.x[2]/best.x[1])
EOF
python3 solve.py
